claims.text: Thompson Palm Springs is located in the heart of downtown Palm Springs.

findings.quote: Located in the heart of downtown, Thompson Palm Springs

claims.text: The hotel blends midcentury modern design with Palm Springs' Rat Pack-era heritage.

findings.quote: Thompson Palm Springs blends iconic midcentury modern design with the city’s Rat Pack‑era heritage.

claims.text: Rooms are reached along a lush open-air path and are bungalow-inspired, set just above the city for privacy and views.

findings.quote: Winding through a lush open‑air path, guests reach 168 bungalow‑inspired rooms set just above the city’s buzz for added privacy and breathtaking views.

claims.text: Every room and suite has a private outdoor space, either a balcony or patio.

findings.quote: Discover distinctive rooms, spacious suites, our 21+ Upper Stories adults‑only retreat, and a stylish two‑bedroom Penthouse all with expansive balconies or patios.

claims.text: Room interiors use desert-inspired elements such as soft stone, light woods and neutral tones with vibrant accents.

findings.quote: Interiors balance desert-inspired elements—soft stone, light woods, and neutral tones with vibrant accents.

claims.text: The hotel has two skyline pools with views of downtown and the desert landscape.

findings.quote: Thompson Palm Springs boasts two skyline pools, each featuring views of the stunning downtown and beautiful desert landscape.

claims.text: The pools have cabanas and an adjacent full-service bar serving al fresco bites and craft cocktails.

findings.quote: the pools are outfitted with luxurious cabanas and an adjacent full-service bar offering menus of al fresco bites, craft cocktails and more.

claims.text: Lola Rose Grand Mezze serves mezze-style Eastern Mediterranean cooking elevated by California seasonal produce.

findings.quote: Lola Rose Grand Mezze offers a bold, mezze-style journey through Eastern Mediterranean flavors, elevated by California’s seasonal bounty.

claims.text: The hotel runs curated experiences including happy hours, DJ sets, art tours and morning yoga.

findings.quote: From lively happy hours and DJ sets to art tours and morning yoga, we're here to make your stay a true reflection of Palm Springs spirit right within the hotel. Don’t miss out on our curated experiences

claims.text: Art throughout the property includes mosaic murals and pieces by local and Indigenous artists.

findings.quote: including mosaic murals, an enormous circular wall sculpture made out of colorful aluminum cans in the lobby, and other pieces created by local and Indigenous artists displayed throughout

claims.text: The resort fee includes drop-off in the house Rivian within a 3-mile radius.

findings.quote: A daily resort fee of $49.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay in order to provide the following services, amenities, and partner discounts and perks
Rivian house car drop off within 3-mile radius

claims.text: The hotel is pet-friendly, with a maximum of 2 pets.

findings.quote: Thompson Palm Springs is a pet-friendly hotel where pets sleep free.
Maximum number of pets is 2.

claims.text: Upper Stories is a tower reserved for adults 21 and older, whose guests get 24/7 access to a private pantry with complimentary cold beverages, a dedicated pool for adults and in-room Sonos sound systems.

findings.quote: Located in Upper Stories, our exclusive adults-only (21+) tower offers a curated collection of elevated amenities designed for a more refined stay.
Enjoy 24/7 access to a private pantry stocked with complimentary cold beverages, dedicated access to an adults-only pool, an in-room Sonos sound system for an immersive audio experience

claims.text: The 1 Bedroom Penthouse looks out on the San Jacinto Mountains and opens onto a massive wraparound terrace.

findings.quote: this expansive 1 Bedroom Penthouse Suite showcases our best views of the San Jacinto Mountain landscapes. A spacious living and dining area flows seamlessly to a massive wraparound terrace

claims.text: The 1 Bedroom Bungalow Suite has the largest terrace on the property, with a private cabana and a dining area overlooking Palm Canyon Drive.

findings.quote: This suite features the largest terrace on property with a private cabana, full dining area overlooking Palm Canyon Drive.

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel is within walking distance of most of the city's highlights.

findings.quote: A long-awaited hotel in the middle of Palm Springs, walking distance to most of the city’s highlights

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the hotel feels sprawling, with just a few levels of rooms and many open-air communal spaces.

findings.quote: It manages to feel sprawling and spread-out with just a few levels of rooms and plenty of pockets of communal open-air spaces equipped with comfy couches and seating throughout the property.

claims.text: A daily resort fee applies to each room, subject to change.

findings.quote: A daily resort fee of $49.00 (subject to change) is applied to each room of your stay

claims.text: The entire resort is smoke- and vape-free, including rooms and balconies.

findings.quote: our entire resort is a smoke- and vape-free environment, including your room and balcony or terrace.

claims.text: The hotel is a cash-free environment.

findings.quote: It is a cash free environment.
